policyReview.title: Mossmouth Video Monetization Policy
policyReview.webAccessEvidence: Official info page link clicked; complete policy body paragraphs4–6 read through webtool on this date. AMP/directalternate returned errors; those failures are not treated as policy changes.

paragraphMeaning.paraphrase: A channel on YouTube,Twitch or similar video-sharing sites has Mossmouth permission to monetize its videos of Mossmouth games, including Lets Plays,reviews,guides and other videos containing game footage. Named coverage includes Spelunky,Spelunky Classic and future Mossmouth games unless otherwise specified.
Do not sell footage, license footage to another party, or sell/claim ownership of any part of the games including art,music assets and code.
A link to the game website is appreciated; sharing videos is welcomed.

policyReview.exactRestrictionExcerpt: You may not, however, sell the footage, license the footage to someone else

scopeDecision.decision: Use publisher-origin gameplay pixels in our independently authored instructional guide under the direct publisher video permission; do not sell stock footage, grant onward footage licences or claim ownership of game assets.
scopeDecision.decisionType: Bounded production interpretation of published permission, not a legal guarantee or an express blanket licence to republish the entire trailer.
scopeDecision.creditPreserved: Game/publisher source URL and trailer-author Derek Lieu credited in description; credits stay out of the teaching picture.

thirdPartyCCAnalysis.observed: Recorder CC permission and game-IP permission are different layers. CC licences attach only to rights the licensor controls; separately licensed third-party content must be marked.
thirdPartyCCAnalysis.possibleInference: In principle an original guide can receive game-IP permission directly from publisher and recorder-copyright permission separately, without claiming the recorder sublicenses the game IP.
thirdPartyCCAnalysis.unresolved: Mossmouth uses the broader words license the footage, with no express third-party-reuse exception. Therefore the old generic uploader CC label is not treated as overriding or conclusively resolving that sentence.
thirdPartyCCAnalysis.v1CandidateStatus: Preserved as held, not retroactively cleared.

reviewedSections: Does a Creative Commons licence give all needed rights

thirdPartyCCAnalysis.doNotConfuse: Neither CC nor this policy transfers ownership of Mossmouth game art/code/music.

inspectedKeyframes.observation: Player stands at a wooden-framed upper doorway; shop and cave ledges visible. Source HUD is hidden in this shot.
Player carries the dog on a small ledge; golden idol sits on the right below a large stone statue.
Player holds the golden idol after leaving its pedestal; no hidden generation state is visible.
Large boulder/debris appears while the player moves toward lower passage near the doorway.
Player still holds idol above the lower doorway area; boulder rolls in lower-left corridor.
Player stands just right of the lower wooden-framed doorway while boulder approaches from left.
Boulder overlaps the player area; red blood and body fragments are visibly emitted. This is a failed approach, not a successful exit.
Player absent from doorway area after collision; boulder continues right.
Doorway remains and debris settles; no next-level transition is shown.
Empty doorway and remaining debris; do not narrate successful completion.

recommendedLocalCut.kind: Single first HD gameplay shot, conservative inward trim before logo transition.
recommendedLocalCut.rationale: Shows entrance, traversal, dog/idol choices and boulder failure near doorway; no promotional logos/title cards inside this conservative range.

optionalSemanticSubranges.meaning: Idol carried and boulder/debris approaching lower doorway
Visible fatal boulder collision and remaining exit; optional depending on lesson emphasis

doNotClaim: A path has been measured through every room
Trailer-time game motion is an internal generator trace

actualOriginalCutEvidence.logoTransitionBoundary: First main shot is still clean atf960; byf1020 publisher logo iris is visible. Do not use that uncertain transition region.
actualOriginalCutEvidence.completenessLimit: These are inspected boundaries, not a claim of exhaustive detection of every montage edit. Entire afterf961 excluded from recommendation. Do not stitch different original shots into a fictional continuous same-level run.

observableBeforeActionResult.before: Player is at an upper entrance doorway with ledges, shop and cave contents.
observableBeforeActionResult.action: Samples show the player moving downward/across platforms, carrying a dog and then a golden idol, followed by a rolling boulder and debris.
observableBeforeActionResult.result: Atf840 player is beside lower doorway, atf870 boulder collision produces blood/body fragments, then doorway remains empty. It is a failed near-exit approach.
observableBeforeActionResult.causalLimit: Temporal event sequence observed; no reconstruction of invisible engine spawning, AI decision or generation rules.
